sources: malaria_collection
https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/malaria-guidance-data-and-analysis
UKHSA malaria guidance, data and analysis collection
malaria characteristics, diagnosis, management, surveillance and epidemiology
The collection covers malaria prevention, diagnosis, management and epidemiological reporting.
It identifies malaria as a serious but preventable notifiable disease in England and Wales.
malaria_prevention_2026
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/malaria-prevention-guidelines-for-travellers-from-the-uk-2026
UKHSA malaria prevention guidelines 2026
annual malaria prevention advice for UK travellers and travel-health professionals
The UK Malaria Expert Advisory Group updates and reissues these traveller guidelines annually.
The 2026 publication is for healthcare workers advising UK-based travellers to malaria-endemic areas.
malaria_prevention_exec
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/malaria-prevention-guidelines-for-travellers-from-the-uk-2026/executive-summary
UKHSA malaria prevention 2026 executive summary
individual pre-travel malaria risk assessment and current recommendation changes
The executive summary requires an individual pre-travel assessment covering medicines, health conditions and allergies.
It advises checking current guidelines and destination recommendations because malaria advice can change.
malaria_imported_stats
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/imported-malaria-in-the-uk-statistics
UKHSA imported malaria statistics
provisional imported-malaria surveillance by species and reporting period
The publication provides epidemiological data for imported malaria in the UK.
Its provisional datasets separate case numbers by species and reporting period.
malaria_annual_reports
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/malaria-in-the-uk-annual-report
UKHSA malaria annual reports
annual analysis of malaria imported into the UK
The annual reports present data on malaria imported into the UK.
The reporting uses cases notified to the Malaria Reference Laboratory and Public Health Scotland.
malaria_risk_form
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/malaria-risk-assessment-form
UKHSA malaria prophylaxis risk-assessment form
specialist prophylaxis queries after consulting national malaria-prevention guidance
The form is for healthcare professionals whose prophylaxis question remains unresolved after consulting the national guidelines.
The March 2026 form routes complex queries to the Malaria Reference Laboratory.
malaria_mrl_handbook
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/malaria-reference-laboratory-mrl-user-handbook
UKHSA Malaria Reference Laboratory handbook
malaria diagnosis, laboratory methods, epidemiological data and prophylaxis advice
The handbook describes reference-laboratory malaria diagnosis and technical advice services.
The laboratory serves NHS, UKHSA, GP and private medical laboratories.
malaria_updates
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/malaria-news-and-updates
UKHSA malaria news and updates
malaria incidents, announcements and temporary prevention-guidance amendments
The page records malaria incidents, announcements and guidance amendments.
Its notices supplement rather than replace the current full prevention guidelines.
mosquito_avoidance
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/mosquito-bite-avoidance-for-travellers
UKHSA mosquito-bite avoidance publication
traveller measures to reduce mosquito-borne infection risk
The publication advises travellers on reducing mosquito-borne infection risk.
It covers infections including chikungunya, dengue, malaria, West Nile virus, yellow fever and Zika.
